name: swarna-live
description: Swarna Live - jewellery buyback estimates on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --env local
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env local
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
